Native.note: Deletes/ends the running cutscene and frees its resources. Native.name: Qsc_Compile
Native.note: Compiles a .qsc SCRIPT SOURCE into a .qvm binary: resolves the path (fcn_004B5B60), pulls the source through ResourceLoad (0x4B5F00), allocates a 0x94-byte compiler context via Mem_Alloc, emits ".qvm" output. Param: qscPath = script source path. RETURNS result object/flag.

Native.name: QScript_Assemble
Native.note: ASSEMBLER stage of the script pipeline: strips comments via regex "{.*:(.*//)*}.*", initialises the parser ("Initialising parser."), generates assembly code and WRITES IT TO "LOCAL:qvmbin.tmp" (also referenced as /0qvmbin.tmp). Params: srcText = script source buffer, srcLen2 = secondary length/context arg. Returns assembly result.

Native.name: Qvm_Execute
Native.note: EXECUTES a loaded QVM script program (the interpreter entry - despite the old analyst label QvmRead). On runtime failure reports "Error in QVM program: %s" / "An error occured in script file: %s". Param: qvm = pointer from Qvm_Load. RETURNS script result value.

Native.name: Qvm_Load
Native.note: Loads a COMPILED .qvm script binary from the virtual filesystem (appends/selects ".qvm"; big 0x130 stack frame builds the script object). Param: qvmPath = path like "LOCAL:common/ai/guard.qvm". RETURNS pointer to the loaded QVM object, 0 on failure (calls engine debug-state check 0x48F1D0 first). Use before executing/attaching scripts.

Native.name: QScript_ParseAndAssemble
Native.note: PARSE+CODEGEN driver: logs "Parsing script and generating assembly code.", runs parser state globals (0xA442D0..), writes output ("Failed to open file '%s' for writing."). Params: srcText = script source, options = parser option word. Part of the QscCompile pipeline feeding QScript_Assemble.

Native.name: Resource_Flush
Native.note: Flushes/finalizes ONE resource entry: walks the global resource list (0x943E38), matches entry+0x34 against the argument, errors "Resource_Flush() : Couldn't locate resource at %p." when absent. Param: resEntry = resource pointer/address to flush.

Native.name: Resource_Load
Native.note: Loads a resource into memory WITH CACHE CHECK: first asks IsResourceLoaded (0x4B5B90); if cached returns the existing entry, otherwise loads and registers it. Params: resourcePath = virtual resource path, outBuffer = receives the data pointer. RETURNS resource entry pointer.

Native.name: Resource_Unload
Native.note: Name from igi.exe error string inside function: "Resource_Unload() : Resource '%s' is not loaded." Unloads a resource by name/path.

Native.name: Is_ResourceLoaded

Params: resourcePath = virtual path, outEntry = receives matching entry. RETURNS non-zero + fills outEntry when found. Resource_Load calls this first - use it to avoid double-loading.

Native.name: Resource_PackUnpack
Native.note: Opens a PACKED resource file via QFile_ReadWrite (0x4B1510, mode string at 0x53B604) and unpacks its contents through the pack table at 0x9436E8. Params: resFile = packed resource path, outBuffer = receives unpacked data. RETURNS entry/result pointer.

Native.name: SymbolRegister_Int16
Native.note: Registers an INT16-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. Sibling of SymbolRegister_Bool8/Int32/Real32 - same thunk shape, different type tag.

Native.name: SymbolRegister_Int32
Native.note: Registers an INT32-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. This is the common integer script-variable registration used by AI/game scripts.

Native.name: SymbolRegister_Real32
Native.note: Registers a REAL32 (float)-typed script variable slot. Params: table, name. RETURNS symbol entry. Pairs with AIFunction_Set/GetScriptRealValue for float storage.

Native.name: LoadingScreen_Show

Param: picVariant = loading-screen type selector. Call before long loads so the player sees feedback.

Native.name: Q_TaskHashTableSet
Native.signature: void Q_TaskHashTableSet(int** table, void* handler, int nameVal, int p4, int p5, int p6, int p7)
Native.note: THE CORE REGISTRAR: inserts an entry into the task/hash table binding a name-value pair to a handler callback. All 7 stack args confirmed by disassembly header (arg_18h..arg_3Ch). Every SymbolRegister* thunk (e.g. 0x4B7EE0 pushes 1,1,0,1,addr,handler,table -> this) and every GAME_DEFINE_OPTIONS registration routes here. Params: table = target hash table, handler = callback invoked for the symbol, nameVal = name/value ref, p4-p7 = type/flag slots (see SymbolRegister thunks for known values).

Native.name: Weapons_CountGet
Native.note: RETURNS the number of weapons defined for the human player: reads global counter 0x57B18C (exactly `mov eax,[0x57B18C]; ret`). That counter is written by the DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCycle definition parser - so this reflects the current weapon-cycle list length. Use to bounds-check weapon indexes before Weapon_GunPickup-style calls.

Native.name: Weapon_GunPickup
Native.note: Gives a GUN pickup to the player: checks the player's already-carried flag (player+0xCF5), reads the weapon id from pickupEntity+8 -> word +0x1C, validates the weapon category via 0x401CF0, hands the weapon over (0x477BF0/0x477C50) and plays the 'weaponpickup_1' sound (0x47CE00/0x4E7200). Params: player = player/Human struct ptr, pickupEntity = the picked-up world entity. Use for custom weapon pickups.

Native.name: Weapon_AmmoPickup
Native.note: Gives an AMMO pickup to the player (same struct conventions as Weapon_GunPickup: player carry-flags and pickup-entity fields drive the grant; plays the pickup sound). Params: player = player struct ptr, pickupEntity = ammo world entity. Use for custom ammo pickups.

Native.name: Human_HitDamage
Native.note: Reads the player XP/hit byte: returns byte [PlayerPtr+0xE1]. Takes no args. Documented alias of HUMAN_HIT_DAMAGE - same address.

Native.name: Human_ViewCam
Native.note: Sets the human's VIEW-CAMERA selector: stores camValue into human struct offset +0x4F0 (verified: mov [ecx+0x4F0],eax; ret - 5-byte setter). Params: human = Human/soldier struct ptr, camValue = camera mode index. Use to switch a soldier's view/camera state directly.

Native.name: Human_TaskViewReset
Native.note: Resets the human's VIEW TANGENT fields to retail defaults: computes tan() of the half-FOV globals 0x5335E8/0x5339C0 (the same globals ENHANCER::FOV_SET writes) and stores them into human+0x1E4 and human+0x1E8, clearing human+0x1EC. Param: human = Human/soldier struct ptr. This is THE retail restore path - call after custom FOV/binocular zoom to return to normal view.

Native.name: Config_GetActivePlayerProfileRecord
Native.note: RETURNS pointer to the ACTIVE PROFILE's graphic-options/config record: computed as 0xBC2388 + 0xD14*[0xBC2384] (verified against retail defaults-reset fcn.00403B70 which walks the same layout). Takes no args. Despite the historical name this returns a record pointer, not a bool. Old analyst name IsPlayerProfileActive was wrong - it returns the record pointer, not a bool.

Native.name: Soldier_Execute
Native.note: Executes/initializes a SOLDIER AI entity in the level. Params: context = task/context object (2nd arg is the soldier ptr - verified: esi=[esp+0x1C] after prologue). The function reads soldier-struct fields +0x800 (ptr), +0x4C4 and +0x254 (sub-object bases passed to spawner 0x4F2060), +0xD1C, then installs a per-soldier callback (0x45C700) into the created object at +0x14 and routes through 0x48A330. Referenced via soldier-task VTABLE at .data 0x53EC90 (not called directly). SOLDIER STRUCT LAYOUT (recovered from the 0x45C190-0x45CA50 vtable family): +0x68 name/string area; +0x254 patrol/waypoint sub-struct (field +0x94 used); +0x2EC param ptr slot; +0x33D flag byte; +0x4C4 object ref; +0x696 active/enable flag (0=off, 1=on); +0x800 ptr; +0xD0C id (0xFFFFFFFF = unset); +0xD14 dword; +0xD1C ptr. Sibling vtable methods: 0x45C190, 0x45C1C0, 0x45C2E0, 0x45C330, 0x45C5A0, 0x45C650, 0x45C750, 0x45C8B0, 0x45CA50 (same struct, enable/disable/reset semantics).

Native.name: Flow_RequestEvent
Native.note: Requests a flow-task event by id (drives the level's flow state machine). Param: eventId = flow event number used in the level flow script. Use from mission flow scripts to trigger scripted transitions. FLOW_EVENT enum: None=0, QUIT=1, INTRO=2, MAINMENU=3, GAME=4, RESTART_GAME=5 (events 6-8 exist internally but have no registered constants).

Native.note: Fills the current menu list box with all player profiles (name per row, row index = profile index). Use inside the profile-selection list box collect-items script.

Native.name: Config_GetActivePlayerProfileIndex
Native.note: RETURNS the index of the currently-active player profile (0-based). Takes no arguments. Use whenever you need which profile is selected, e.g. before Config_DeletePlayerProfile.

Native.name: Config_SetActivePlayerProfileIndex
Native.note: Makes 'index' the active player profile. Param: index = 0-based profile index (must exist; see Config_GetNumberOfPlayerProfiles).

Native.name: Config_CreateNewPlayerProfile
Native.note: Creates a new player profile. Params: name = new profile name (string), sourceIndex = existing profile index to copy initial settings from. RETURNS 1 on success, 0 on failure (e.g. name taken/slots full). Use on the create-profile screen.

Native.name: Config_DeletePlayerProfile
Native.note: Deletes a player profile. Param: index = 0-based profile index to delete. RETURNS 1 on success, 0 on failure. Do not delete the last remaining profile; refresh your list box afterwards.

Native.name: Config_PlayerGetActiveMission
Native.note: Returns the active (reached) mission number of ANY profile. Param: profileIndex = 0-based profile index. Use on the profile/mission screens to show progress without switching profiles.

Native.name: Config_GetNumberOfPlayerProfiles
Native.note: RETURNS how many player profiles exist. Use to bounds-check indexes and to size profile lists.

Native.name: Config_FillMissionSelectionBox
Native.note: Fills the current menu list box with missions selectable for the active profile (respects unlocked progress). Use inside the mission-selection list box collect-items script.

Native.name: Config_FillMissionPictureBox
Native.note: Fills the current picture box with the selected mission's briefing image. Use inside the mission-picture control's script right after a mission row is chosen.

Native.name: Config_FillMissionTextBox
Native.note: Fills the current text box with the selected mission's briefing text. Use inside the mission-briefing text control's script.

Native.name: Config_FillScreenResolutionListBox
Native.note: Fills the currently-active menu list box with the screen resolutions available for a device. Param: deviceIndex = render-device index. Use only inside a menu list box 'collect items' script so the items land in that control.

Native.name: Config_FillRenderDeviceListBox
Native.note: Fills the currently-active menu list box with installed render devices (Direct3D device GUIDs/names). Use inside a list box collect-items script on the video-options screen.

Native.name: Config_GameOptionsInputGetInvertMouse
Native.note: RETURNS the invert-mouse setting when the engine writes/reads a config game-options block (1 = inverted, 0 = normal). Takes no args. Pairs with Config_GameOptionsInputSetInvertMouse.

Native.name: Config_GameOptionsInputGetMouseSensitivity
Native.note: RETURNS the stored mouse-sensitivity integer from the game-options config context. Takes no args.

Native.name: Config_GameOptionsInputGetBloodEnabled
Native.note: RETURNS the blood-enabled flag from the game-options config context (1/0). Takes no args.

Native.name: Config_GameOptionsInputSetInvertMouse
Native.note: Sets invert-mouse in the GAME-OPTIONS block while a config file is parsed (the GO_* writer side; runtime getter/setter pair lives on the profile). Param: invert = 1 inverted, 0 normal. Use only inside config .qsc write-out contexts.

Native.name: Config_GameOptionsInputSetMouseSensitivity
Native.note: Sets mouse-sensitivity in the config game-options write-out context. Param: value = sensitivity as stored by the options screen (integer scale).

Native.name: Config_GameOptionsInputSetBloodEnabled
Native.note: Sets blood-enabled in the config game-options write-out context. Param: blood = 1 on, 0 off.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetResolution
Native.note: Applies a screen resolution to the active profile and re-initialises the display. Param: modeIndex = index from Config_FillScreenResolutionListBox entries. Use in the video-options screen script.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetTransparency
Native.note: Toggles transparency for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 enable, 0 disable. Video-options screen.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetDevice
Native.note: Applies a render device to the active profile. Param: deviceIndex = index from Config_FillRenderDeviceListBox. Use in video-options screen script.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetPerformanceFlags
Native.note: Sets the raw graphics performance/detail flag bits on the active profile. Param: flags = bitmask (get a valid one from Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfFlagsFromLevel).

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetResolution
Native.note: Returns the active profile's display-mode/resolution index (same index space as Config_GraphicOptionsSetResolution). Use in video-options UI scripts to preselect the current value.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetTransparency
Native.note: Returns 1 if transparency is enabled for the active profile, else 0.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetDevice
Native.note: Returns the active profile's render-device index (index into the device list). Use in video-options UI scripts.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetGamma
Native.note: Returns the active profile's gamma as a float. Use to initialise your own gamma slider/UI.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerformanceFlags
Native.note: Returns the active profile's graphics performance flag bitmask.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfFlagsFromLevel
Native.note: Converts a detail LEVEL number into its performance-flag bitmask. Param: level = 0..Config_GraphicOptionsNumPerfLevels()-1. Use when the user picks a named detail preset.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsGetPerfLevelFromFlags
Native.note: Converts a performance-flag bitmask back into its detail LEVEL number. Param: flags = bitmask from the profile/performance setting. Use to show the current detail level in UI.

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsNumPerfLevels
Native.note: RETURNS the number of graphics detail levels the engine supports (constant). Use to build the detail-level slider/list.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSoundsEffects
Native.note: Enables/disables sound effects for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 on, 0 off.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSoundsEffectsVolume
Native.note: Sets SFX volume for the active profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetMusic
Native.note: Enables/disables music for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 on, 0 off.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetMusicVolume
Native.note: Sets music volume for the active profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0 (pops a float arg - pass a float!).

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSpeech
Native.note: Enables/disables radio speech for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 on, 0 off.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetSpeechVolume
Native.note: Sets speech volume for the active profile. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsSetReverseStereo
Native.note: Toggles reversed stereo channels for the active profile. Param: onOff = 1 reverse, 0 normal.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSoundsEffects
Native.note: Returns 1 if sound effects are enabled for the active profile, else 0.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSoundsEffectsVolume
Native.note: Returns the active profile's SFX volume (0.0-1.0).

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetMusic
Native.note: Returns 1 if music is enabled for the active profile, else 0.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetMusicVolume
Native.note: Returns the active profile's music volume (0.0-1.0).

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSpeech
Native.note: Returns 1 if speech is enabled for the active profile, else 0.

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetSpeechVolume
Native.note: Returns the active profile's speech volume (0.0-1.0).

Native.name: Config_SoundOptionsGetReverseStereo
Native.note: Returns 1 if stereo is reversed for the active profile, else 0.

Native.name: Config_SetContentControlPassword
Native.note: Menu-script setter form (argc=0): same address registered twice by igi.exe - site 0x4034C1 pushes str "Config_SetContentControlPassword" -> registrar 0x4B8890. Password comes from the script context, not an explicit arg. Returns 1.

Native.name: Config_GetContentControlPassword
Native.note: RETURNS the stored content-control (parental lock) password string. Takes no args. Compare against user input or pass to Config_VerifyContentControlPassword.

Native.name: Config_VerifyContentControlPassword
Native.note: Checks a password attempt against the stored content-control password. Param: password = string to test. RETURNS non-zero when correct, 0 when wrong. Use before unlocking violent-content options.

Native.name: Config_IsContentControlPasswordEnabled
Native.note: RETURNS 1 if a content-control password is SET (parental lock active), else 0. Takes no args. Use to decide whether to ask for the password.

Native.name: Config_IsGermany
Native.note: RETURNS 1 when running the GERMAN retail build (censored variant), 0 otherwise. Takes no args. German builds gate blood/gore - check before forcing such effects.

Native.name: DefineQ_Material
Native.note: Defines a Q-material (surface material) entry while a material definition block is parsed. Called BY the engine's own define-block parser - call only from material .qsc definition contexts; arg layout follows the Define block grammar (registration argc unknown).

Native.name: Define_GameMaterial
Native.note: Defines a GameMaterial entry during a game-material definition block (855-byte parser function). Call only from gamematerial .qsc definition contexts; arg layout follows the Define block grammar (registration argc unknown).

Native.name: Define_HumanPlayerWeaponCycle
Native.note: Collects the weapon-cycle list for the human player: loops the parsed entries and stores them into the cycle table at 0x56DF1C with count at 0x56DF18 (verified in igi.exe). Call within a humanplayer weapon-cycle definition block; argc unknown (parser context).

Native.name: Define_HumanPlayerWeaponCategory
Native.note: Registers one weapon-category entry for the human player during a humanplayer definition block (argc unknown - parser context). Pairs with DefineHumanPlayerWeaponCycle/Cycle ordering.

Native.name: Define_HumanPlayerAmmoLimit
Native.note: Registers an ammo-limit entry (max carried ammo class) for the human player during a humanplayer definition block (argc unknown - parser context).

Native.name: MovieSubtitle_RegisterFont
Native.note: Registers a font used by in-game movie subtitles (16 callsites in body; argc unknown - parser context). Call from subtitle/font definition blocks before any MovieSubtitle_RegisterText that uses it.

Native.name: MovieSubtitle_RegisterText
Native.note: Registers one subtitle text entry (string + timing) shown over movies/briefings (argc unknown - parser context). Call after the font registration it should use.

Native.name: Game_SetMission
Native.note: Selects the mission the game will run/load next. Param: mission = mission index 1..14. Use before Level_Start/level load flow when jumping straight into a mission.

Native.name: Game_SetMusicVolume
Native.note: Live-sets music volume through the profile real-value setter (fcn.004B8A50): retail body constructs 1.0f (0x3FF00000) and stores via fstp. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Called by ingamemenu.qvm options sliders.

Native.name: Game_SetSFXVolume
Native.note: Live-sets sound-effects volume through the profile real-value setter (fcn.004B8A50), same 1.0f construction pattern. Param: volume = float 0.0-1.0. Called by ingamemenu.qvm options sliders.

Native.name: MenuManager_RequestScreen
Native.note: Requests a menu screen by id through the menu manager (queued request). Params: screenId = retail screen resource id, flags = request modifier (0 = normal). Use outside the menu stack internals when you just want a screen opened next tick.

Native.name: MenuManager_LeaveMenus
Native.note: Leaves/closes the whole menu system returning to gameplay. Params: two ints observed in retail calls (pass 0,0). Use to exit from custom menus.

Native.name: MenuManager_SetLanguage
Native.note: Switches menu/UI language at runtime. Param: langIndex = language index matching the LANGUAGE\ folder tables. Call before pushing screens so texts load in the right language.

Native.name: MenuManager_PushScreen
Native.note: Pushes a screen onto the menu stack: allocates the screen object (objsize 0x2898) and stores it in the manager's screen stack at mgr+0x27EC (verified in igi.exe). Param: screenId = retail screen id. Remember to MenuManager_PopScreen when done.

Native.name: MenuManager_PopScreen
Native.note: Pops the top screen off the menu stack (destroys it) revealing the one beneath. Param: param = pass-through argument observed in retail calls (pass 0). Pair with MenuManager_PushScreen.

Native.name: MenuManager_ForceUpdateWindow
Native.note: Forces the menu manager to redraw/update its windows this frame. Param: observed retail value 0. Use after changing control contents from script.

Native.name: MenuManager_ActivatePopupScreen
Native.note: Activates a popup screen on top of the current menus (e.g. confirmation dialogs; retail scripts call MenuManager_ActivatePopupScreen(930)). Param: popupId = retail popup screen id. Use for custom confirmations.

Native.name: MenuManager_DeactivatePopuScreen
Native.note: Deactivates the currently-active popup screen and returns to the screen beneath. Takes no args. Pair with MenuManager_ActivatePopupScreen. NOTE: name mirrors the retail registration string exactly, including its "Popu" typo - do not "fix" it against the binary.

Native.name: MenuManager_SetEnabled
Native.note: Enables/disables menu-manager input processing. Param: enabled = 1 menus react to input, 0 frozen. Use to freeze menus during scripted sequences.

Native.name: ControlsMenu_ConvertFloatFromOffset
Native.note: Converts a controls-menu slider/storage OFFSET into its float value (0.0-1.0 range used by the control configuration bars). Param: offset = raw integer offset stored for that control binding. Use when reading/writing control bindings from script.

Native.name: ControlsMenu_ConvertOffsetFromFloat
Native.note: Inverse of ControlsMenu_ConvertFloatFromOffset: converts a float control value into the raw storage offset. Param: value = float 0.0-1.0. Use when saving a modified binding back.

Native.name: AIAction_Patrol
Native.signature: void AIAction_Patrol(int target, int mustBeZero, int flags)
Native.note: Orders the AI into PATROL behaviour. Params: target = patrol goal/node reference from your script, mustBeZero = retail template always passes 0, flags = AIACTIONFLAG enum: NONE=0, PUSHABLE=1 (action may be replaced by higher priority). Use inside AI event handlers e.g. AIEVENT_IDLE branch. Template in igi.exe: AIAction_Patrol(xxxx, 0, AIACTIONFLAG_NONE).

Native.name: AIAction_Combat
Native.note: Orders the AI into COMBAT behaviour vs its current enemy. Param: param = combat argument from the calling script (retail guard scripts pass their combat target/context value). Use in AIEVENT_COMBAT branches.

Native.name: AIAction_Dead
Native.note: Runs the DEATH handling action for the AI (plays death, releases tasks). Param: param = death context value passed by retail scripts. Use in AIEVENT_DEAD handler.

Native.name: AIAction_FallFlat
Native.note: Knocks the AI flat on the ground (ragdoll-ish fall, e.g. after explosion/surrender). Params: two ints observed in retail calls (pass 0,0 unless mapping specific values). Use for scripted knockdowns.

Native.name: AIAction_Activate
Native.signature: void AIAction_Activate(int target, int param2, int flags)
Native.note: Generic ACTIVATE action: sends the AI to activate/use an object (switch, door, alarm...). Params: target = object/task reference, param2 = secondary value (retail passes 0), flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use in AI handlers for alarm/objective responses.

Native.name: AIAction_WalkToNode
Native.note: Walks the AI to a nav node. Params: nodeId = graph/node id from the level nav data, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use for calm movement in AI scripts.

Native.name: AIAction_RunToNode
Native.note: Runs the AI to a nav node (fast). Same params as AIAction_WalkToNode: nodeId = node id, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Native.name: AIAction_FireAtNode
Native.signature: void AIAction_FireAtNode(int nodeId, int p1, int p2, int p3, int p4)
Native.note: Makes the AI fire AT a nav-node position. Params: nodeId = target node id, remaining 4 args = firing stance/behaviour values observed in retail AI scripts (map before inventing values). Use in combat handlers when target is a position.

Native.name: AIAction_FireAtTask
Native.signature: void AIAction_FireAtTask(int taskId, int p1, int p2, int p3, int p4)
Native.note: Makes the AI fire AT a task/object entity. Params: taskId = target task/entity id, remaining 4 args = firing behaviour values (same layout family as FireAtNode). Use in combat handlers when target is an entity.

Native.name: AIAction_PlayAnimation
Native.note: Plays an animation on the AI. Params: animationId = animation entry id (see AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry), flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Native.name: AIAction_PlaySound
Native.signature: void AIAction_PlaySound(int soundId, int param2, int flags)
Native.note: Plays a sound from the AI (voice barks etc.). Params: soundId = sound/event id, param2 = observed 0 in retail, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Native.name: AIAction_MoveToEvent
Native.note: Moves the AI toward the source position of an EVENT it received. Params: eventId = AIEVENT_* whose position to move to, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1). Use in event handlers (gunshot heard -> move there).

Native.name: AIAction_LookAtEvent
Native.note: Turns the AI to LOOK toward an event's source without moving. Params: eventId = AIEVENT_* value, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Native.name: AIAction_Stunned
Native.note: Stuns the AI (flashbang/knockout reaction). Params: param1 = stun duration/context value, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Native.name: AIAction_KickGrenade
Native.note: Kicks a nearby live grenade away (retail soldier behaviour). Param: param = grenade/context reference from the event. Use in grenade-event handlers.

Native.name: AIAction_RunPanicking
Native.note: Sends the AI into PANIC running (civilians under fire). Params: param1 = panic target/context, flags = AIACTIONFLAG (NONE=0/PUSHABLE=1).

Native.name: AIAction_Idle
Native.note: Puts the AI into IDLE (stands, resumes idle animation countdown). Param: idle context value (retail scripts pass their idle value). Use in AIEVENT_IDLE handler instead of Patrol for stationary guards.

Native.name: AIAction_SetCombat
Native.note: Force-sets the AI's COMBAT ENEMY/target. Param: enemyId = enemy entity/id to engage. Use to make an AI attack a specific target regardless of detection.

Native.name: AIFunction_DefaultHandler
Native.note: The default AI event handler: call this for any AIEVENT_* your script does not handle explicitly (retail template shows it as the else-branch body). Takes no args. Put inside every event if-else chain as fallback.

Native.name: AIFunction_RemoveAlarmActions
Native.note: Removes all queued ALARM-related actions from this AI (calms it down). Takes no args. Use to de-escalate an NPC you control.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetViewLength
Native.note: Sets this AI's VIEW LENGTH - how far it can see. Param: length = view distance in engine units. Use in AI init (AIEVENT_CREATE) to buff/nerf vision.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmViewLength
Native.note: Sets view length WHILE AN ALARM IS ON (separate stat from normal vision). Param: length = distance in engine units. Use in AI init.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetViewAlpha
Native.note: Sets view ALPHA - the detection speed/gain of normal vision. Param: alpha = engine detection factor. Higher = spots player faster. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetViewGamma
Native.note: Sets view GAMMA - secondary vision shaping factor for detection. Param: gamma = engine factor. Use in AI init alongside SetViewAlpha.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewLength
Native.note: Sets SECONDARY view length (peripheral/short-range channel). Param: length = distance in engine units.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryAlarmViewLength
Native.note: Sets secondary view length during alarms. Param: length = distance in engine units.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewAlpha
Native.note: Sets secondary-view detection gain. Param: alpha = engine factor.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewGamma
Native.note: Sets secondary-view gamma shaping factor. Param: gamma = engine factor.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetEventPriority
Native.note: Sets the priority of the CURRENT event being handled (decides which queued event wins). Param: priority = engine priority number. Use inside an event handler.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetInvulnerability
Native.note: Makes this AI invulnerable. Param: onOff = 1 immune to damage, 0 normal. Great for boss/scripted NPCs. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE or anytime.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetInstantDeath
Native.note: When on, any hit instantly kills this AI (no damage pooling). Param: onOff = 1 one-shot kills, 0 normal health. Use for scripted one-shot enemies.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetDeathAnimation
Native.note: Overrides the death animation played when this AI dies. Param: animId = animation entry id. Use in AI init for custom deaths.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID
Native.note: Binds an ALARM trigger object to this AI (which alarm switch it responds to/runs to). Param: id = alarm trigger id from the level. Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID(xx).

Native.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID
Native.note: Binds the ALARM CONTROL (the raised-alarm device) this AI uses. Param: id = alarm control id from the level. Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID(xx).

Native.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess
Native.note: Sets HOW the AI treats the alarm route. Param: access = AIALARMACCESS enum: BEFORECOMBAT=0 (run for the alarm first), AFTERCOMBAT=1 (fight first, raise alarm after). Retail template: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess(AIALARMACCESS_BEFORECOMBAT).

Native.name: AIFunction_SetGunnerID
Native.note: Assigns which mounted-gunner slot this AI mans. Param: gunnerId = gunner position id. Use in AI init for turret/mounted-gun NPCs.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue
Native.note: Writes an AI-script integer variable. Params: varId = script variable index, value = new integer. Use for custom AI state communication between scripts.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetScriptRealValue
Native.note: Writes an AI-script real (float) variable. Params: varId = script variable index, value = float. Pairs with AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue.

Native.name: AIFunction_SetAnimationInterval
Native.note: Sets playback INTERVAL for an animation entry. Params: entryIndex = animation entry added via AddAnimationEntry, interval = frame/tick interval. Use when tuning scripted animations.

Native.name: AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry
Native.note: Adds an animation ENTRY to this AI's available set (builds the pick-list GetAnimationToPlay draws from). Params: animationId = animation resource id, data = entry config value. Use in AIEVENT_CREATE before playing custom animations.

Native.name: AIFunction_SendResponse
Native.note: Sends the AI's RESPONSE to the current event (used for ALERT_RESPONSE chains so buddy AIs react too). Takes no args. Call inside alert handlers.

Native.name: Define_AmmoType
Native.note: Defines an AMMO TYPE inside an ammo definition block of a .qsc/.cfg script (515-byte parser body; igi.exe embeds str 'DefineAmmoType'). Args follow the Define-ammo grammar (name, damage, range, clip...) - not fully mapped, treat as parser-internal. Do NOT call outside its define block.

Native.name: Define_Mission
Native.note: Defines a MISSION entry during mission-list parsing (480-byte parser). Called by the engine's mission definition grammar; do NOT call from gameplay scripts.

Native.name: LevelFlow_GetBreakCutSceneKey
Native.note: RETURNS the key code currently bound to 'skip/break cutscene'. Takes no args. Use in cutscene player loops to detect the skip key press.

Native.name: LevelFlow_LevelFailed
Native.note: Signals that the level FAILED - triggers the retail failure flow (fail sound, restart/quit menu). Takes no args. Call when your scripted objective fails.

Native.name: LevelFlow_IsCountryUSA
Native.note: RETURNS 1 if the running build is a USA country build, 0 otherwise (affects censorship/content paths like blood). Takes no args. Check before enabling content that country builds gate.

Native.name: Script_SetWarningLevel
Native.note: Sets how loudly the script system reports warnings while parsing/running (igi.exe embeds its name WITH leading underscore: '_Script_SetWarningLevel'). Param: level = warning verbosity threshold. Use at the top of scripts you want silenced or extra-chatty.

Native.name: Break_Script
Native.note: Breaks/aborts the currently-executing script at this point (70-byte function). Takes no args. Use as an early-exit inside .qsc scripts.

Native.name: Define_MagicObj
Native.note: Defines a MAGIC OBJECT type during magicobj definition parsing (pairs with the MAGICOBJ\ folder data). Parser-context only.

Native.name: Create_TerrainTileMap
Native.note: Creates the TERRAIN TILE MAP for a level during level load (113-byte function). Engine-internal: called by the terrain loader, not meant for gameplay scripts.

Native.name: Define_Group
Native.note: Defines a GROUP entry (sound-group/entity grouping) during definition parsing. Parser-context only.

Native.name: Define_Sound
Native.note: Defines a SOUND entry (file + attenuation params) inside sound definition blocks - OpenIGI reimplements it as SoundDefinitionRegistry.Define(SoundDefinitionKind.Sound). Call only from sound .qsc define blocks.

Native.name: Define_Graph
Native.note: Defines a GRAPH (sound/graph transition graph) entry inside definition blocks - OpenIGI maps it to SoundDefinitionKind.Graph. Parser-context only.

Native.name: Define_TriggerOnce
Native.note: Defines a fire-once TRIGGER entry inside definition blocks - OpenIGI maps it to SoundDefinitionKind.TriggerOnce. Parser-context only.

Native.name: Task_New
Native.note: Instantiates a new game task from a declared type (731-byte factory; OpenIGI registers Task_New reading the type name then declared params). Call inside task blocks after Task_DeclareParameters; argc unknown (parser context).

Native.name: Task_DeclareParameters
Native.note: Declares the parameter list of the task currently being defined inside a .qsc task block (OpenIGI TaskScriptCommands implements it reading a type name + parameter names). Call as FIRST statement of a task definition; argc unknown (parser context).

Native.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerID
Native.note: RETURNS the id of the alarm trigger bound to this AI (see AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID). Takes no args. Use in handlers to check which alarm applies.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlID
Native.note: RETURNS the bound alarm-control id. Takes no args.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmAccess
Native.note: RETURNS the current AIALARMACCESS mode: BEFORECOMBAT=0, AFTERCOMBAT=1. Takes no args.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerID
Native.note: RETURNS this AI's assigned gunner slot id. Takes no args.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlStatus
Native.note: RETURNS the status/state of the bound alarm control (raised/used state as tracked by the engine). Takes no args.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerStatus
Native.note: RETURNS the status of this AI's gunner post (manned/state value). Takes no args.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetScriptIntegerValue
Native.note: READS an AI-script integer variable written by AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue. Param: varId = variable index. RETURNS the integer.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetCurrentEventType
Native.note: RETURNS the AIEVENT_* value currently being handled - the backbone of every AI script's if/else chain. Enum: CREATE=0, DELETE=1, DEAD=2, ANIMATION=3, IDLE=4, ALERT=5, ALERT_RESPONSE=6, COMBAT=7, ALARMON=8, ALARMOFF=9, WALK=10, GROUNDIMPACT=11, DOOR=12, FENCE=13, LADDER=14, TAKINGDAMAGE=15, GUNSHOT=16, GRENADETHROWN=17, GRENADELAND=18, FLASHBANG=19, GUNSHOTMISS=20, EXPLOSION=21, ENEMYDETECTION=22, FRIENDLYDETECTION=23. Takes no args.

Native.name: AIFunction_IsEventBehind
Native.note: RETURNS non-zero if the current event came from BEHIND the AI (direction test used for reaction animations). Takes no script args per retail table (engine reads an internal slot via ebp+8). Use in alert/detection handlers.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetAnimationToPlay
Native.note: RETURNS which animation entry the engine decided to play for the current event/action (useful to log or override reactions). Per retail table takes no script args; machine code also touches an [ebp+8] slot (internal context).

Native.name: Config_GraphicOptionsSetGamma
Native.note: Sets and immediately applies gamma to the active profile (also feeds the live lighting math through the profile record +0x220). Param: gamma = float (retail default 1.0). Use in video-options screen script or your own gamma slider.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue
Native.note: READS an AI-script real (float) variable. Param: varId = variable index. RETURNS the float.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetRandomValue
Native.note: RETURNS a random value below 'max' (returns Real per retail table). Param: max = upper bound. Use for randomized behaviour delays/targets in AI scripts.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetEventDistance
Native.note: RETURNS the DISTANCE to the source of the current event (Real). Takes no args. Use inside event handlers e.g. 'if gunshot closer than X then investigate'.

Native.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerDistance
Native.note: RETURNS the distance between this AI and its bound ALARM TRIGGER (Real). Takes no args. Use to decide running vs fighting for the alarm.

Native.name: App_ContextSetDebugged
Native.note: Sets the app-level DEBUGGED flag (global 0x5C8BF8). Param: state = 1 mark debugger attached/debug mode, 0 clear. BlankName's IGIPatch calls this by name. Use to toggle engine debug paths.

Native.name: App_ContextSetDebugtextState
Native.note: Toggles on-screen DEBUG TEXT output (global 0x5C8BF4). Param: state = 1 show engine debug text, 0 hide. Handy while reverse-engineering other systems.

Native.name: App_ContextSetLightmapsUsed
Native.note: Enables/disables OBJECT lightmaps globally (global 0x5C8BE4) - the verified retail lightmap setter. Param: used = 1 use object lightmaps, 0 flat-lit. Use for graphics enhancers (this is what IGIPatch's lightmap toggles call).

Native.name: App_ContextSetTerrainLightmapsUsed
Native.note: Enables/disables TERRAIN lightmaps globally (global 0x5C8BE8). Param: used = 1 lit terrain, 0 unlit. Pair with AppContext_SetLightmapsUsed for full lighting control.

Native.name: Config_GetActiveGraphicOptions
Native.note: Returns a pointer to the ACTIVE PROFILE's graphic-options record inside the global config array. The record base is 0xBC2394 + 0xD14 * activeProfileIndex (verified in igi.exe). Useful for reading/writing raw graphic fields directly (gamma sits at record+0x220).

Native.name: Display_GetActiveMode

Native.name: Display_SetMode

Param: modeStruct = pointer to a display-mode struct (same layout Display_GetActiveMode returns). RETURNS 0 on failure, non-zero on success.

Native.name: Picture_GetWidth

Native.name: Frames_GetUpdateCounter
Native.note: Returns the update-loop counter at game-context field +0x34. Frames_Set resets it and the retail main loop increments it once per simulation/update pass; gameplay timeout code compares against this value.

Native.name: Frames_GetTaskCounter
Native.note: Returns the second task/processing counter at game-context field +0x38. Frames_Set resets it and the retail main loop increments it during the second processing pass.

Native.name: Game_TimingBegin
Native.note: Begins a nested timing interval: starts the retail timer when the timing depth is zero, then increments the depth counter. Level_Start and Game_Restart bracket their load work with this helper and Game_TimingEnd.

Native.name: Game_TimingEnd
Native.note: Ends a nested timing interval: decrements the depth counter and, at zero, adds elapsed timer ticks to game-context field +0x50 and clears the interval start timestamp.
